title: Affine sheaf-Hom is right adjoint to restriction
statement: Let f:Y \to X be an affine morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and let A=f_*O_Y. The sheaf-Hom functor Hom_{O_X}(A,-) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] from O_X-modules to A-modules is right adjoint to restriction of scalars from A-modules to O_X-modules. On an affine open U=Spec(R) of X, with f^{-1}(U)=Spec(S), its sections are Hom_R(S,F(U)) for every O_X-module F, and the counit is evaluation at the unit 1 in S.

proof.text: Apply the sheaf coinduction adjunction to f, without needing affineness, obtaining H,i,adj, the multiplication action and evaluation-at-one counit.
The restricted unit of f_*O_Y is definitionally the pushforward of the unit O_Y-module. The unit is quasi-coherent; affine pushforward preserves quasi-coherence. Hence M=T(A) is quasi-coherent.

For an affine open U define ev(phi) as the component at the identity of U. Evaluation is additive; its scalar compatibility follows from the internal-Hom scalar action and the identity restriction on O_X(U). The affine evaluation theorem makes ev bijective, so LinearEquiv.ofBijective gives the stated linear equivalence with its evaluation formula. Combine it with the action and counit from step 1.
